omissions.explanation: Service-owned types and operations are visible; live object instances and their current relations are not yet Node Interface inputs.
Adapter declarations and recorded model inventories are not Node routes; an inventory match cannot expose model invocation here.
Host schedules and workflows are harness plumbing, not governed service state.
